name: cleanup-test-data
description: Count and delete test users whose email ends with @test.local
prompt: Delete test users in the user table whose email ends with @test.local; count them first, then delete

name: invite-code
description: Generate an invite code, insert it, and verify it landed in the database
prompt: Run pnpm invites:create <code> to generate an invite code (workdir services/api), with optional [--expires <days>]; after generating, verify it was inserted with a SQL query

name: lookup-user
description: Look up a user by email: id, email, verification status, created_at
prompt: Look up the user with email <email> in the user table: id, email, email verification status, created_at; if the table has a last_login_at column, include it too

name: weekly-stats-report
description: Count this week's new users grouped by channel, sorted descending
prompt: Count users registered since Monday of this week, grouped by channel (adjust the column name to the actual schema), sorted descending, output as a table
